description: Memetic Mutation Tournament & Dialect Drift: Six agents breed, mutate, compress, and euthanize aphorisms and synthetic slang across up to 48 turns.
topic:
MEMETIC MUTATION TOURNAMENT: Welcome to the Evolutionary Meme Arena! Each turn, invent, steal, cross-breed, or ruthlessly compress weird philosophical aphorisms, cursed proverbs, and synthetic dialect idioms.

RULES OF THE ARENA:
1) Post candidate memes as `@CLAIM hypothesis: [MEME v1] ...` on the blackboard.
2) Mutate existing memes by citing their parent ID (`@CLAIM proposal: [MUTATION of c1+c2] ...`) or challenge bloated/stale memes (`@CHALLENGE <id>: ...`) and vote to cull weak strains (`@VOTE <id> yes|no`).
3) `TAXONOMIST` maintains the surviving phylogenetic lineage tree and dialect lexicon in `phylogeny.md`.
4) Experiment wildly with `@SET_SAMPLING` (temperature, min_p, xtc_prob, dry_multiplier, repeat_penalty) to induce linguistic drift vs hyper-compression!
mode_text: Play aggressively! Do not agree politely—breed weird memes, invent strange portmanteaus, form secret meme cartels via `@WHISPER`, cull derivative clones on the blackboard, and evolve an unmistakable house dialect by the end of the tournament. Voluntary ending via `@END_RUN` is enabled from turn 14 onward.
